description: Plannotator for Qwen Code. PermissionRequest on exit_plan_mode opens the plan review and waits for the decision (timeout in milliseconds: Qwen reads a command-hook timeout of 1000 or more as milliseconds, and before 2026-09-12 read every timeout so; here 96 hours). PreToolUse on enter_plan_mode adds Plannotator's planning context when it is turned on, and prints nothing otherwise (timeout 5000 ms). PLANNOTATOR_ORIGIN names the agent for the review UI.
